died.name: Conradin
died.desc: last direct heir of the House of Hohenstaufen
died.cause: prior to execution by beheading at the age of 16
died.last_words: O my mother! how deep will be thy sorrow at the news of this day!

died.name: Walter Raleigh
died.cause: as he lay ready to be beheaded in the Old Palace Yard at the Palace of Westminster
died.last_words: What dost thou fear? Strike, man, strike!

died.name: Leon Czolgosz
died.desc: assassin of U.S. President William McKinley
died.last_words: I killed the President because he was the enemy of the good people-the good working people. I am not sorry for my crime. I am sorry I could not see my father.

died.name: Louis B. Mayer
died.desc: Canadian-American film producer, co-founder of Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer

born.name: Fernando Álvarez de Toledo, 3rd Duke of Alba
born.cause: on learning that the King was to visit him

born.name: Velma Barfield
born.last_words: I know that everybody has gone through a lot of pain, all the families connected, and I am sorry, and I want to thank everybody who have been supporting me all these six years.
